# dbus

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/proc/dbus"
```

Package dbus is the SDK's message bus client, on the standard library: who owns a well-known name on a D-Bus daemon and every change of it — what proc/service's Type=dbus is up on — and a name a Go service owns.

```
conn, err := dbus.NewConn(ctx, dbus.SystemBusAddress())
cfg.BusWatcher = conn // proc/service: Type=dbus, BusName=
defer conn.Close()
```

A service that is itself a Type=dbus unit owns its name with RequestName once it is ready to answer on it.

### Bounds

Unix sockets only (unix:path=, unix:abstract=), AUTH EXTERNAL only, no launched bus. A header past 64 KiB closes the connection ([CodeProtocolViolation](#CodeProtocolViolation)); a body past 1 MiB is dropped unread. A call waits for its context ([CodeCallCancelled](#CodeCallCancelled)); the bus's own refusal is [CodeCallFailed](#CodeCallFailed), its name in the error field. Every call, and the authentication, waits 25 seconds at most — sd-bus's default reply timeout — or its context's deadline when sooner ([CodeCallTimeout](#CodeCallTimeout)). Linux only: NewConn is UNSUPPORTED\_PLATFORM elsewhere.

<a name="NewConn"></a>
## func [NewConn](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/dbus/gen_facade.go>)

```go
func NewConn(ctx context.Context, address string) (*Conn, error)
```

NewConn connects to the bus at address, authenticates and says Hello, or returns ADDRESS\_INVALID, BUS\_UNREACHABLE, AUTH\_REFUSED or PROTOCOL\_VIOLATION; UNSUPPORTED\_PLATFORM off Linux.

<a name="Conn"></a>
## type [Conn](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/dbus/gen_facade.go>)

Conn is one connection to a message bus, safe for concurrent use; a proc/service BusWatcher as it is.

```go
type Conn = svcdbus.Conn
```

Conn is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/dbus.Conn`, declared as:

```go
type Conn struct{}
```

<a name="Conn.Close"></a>
### func \(Conn\) [Close](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/dbus/conn.go>)

```go
func (*Conn) Close() error
```

Close closes the connection: every call in flight ends with CONN\_CLOSED, every watch's channel is closed, and the names the connection owned are released by the bus. It is idempotent.

<a name="Conn.NameOwner"></a>
### func \(Conn\) [NameOwner](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/dbus/conn.go>)

```go
func (*Conn) NameOwner(ctx context.Context, name string) (string, error)
```

NameOwner returns the unique name of name's owner, empty when it has none. A name that is not well-known is NAME\_INVALID.

<a name="Conn.ReleaseName"></a>

```go
func (*Conn) ReleaseName(ctx context.Context, name string) (bool, error)
```

ReleaseName gives name back: true when the connection owned it, false when it did not.

<a name="Conn.RequestName"></a>
### func \(Conn\) [RequestName](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/dbus/conn.go>)

```go
func (*Conn) RequestName(ctx context.Context, name string) (bool, error)
```

RequestName asks the bus for name, never queued: true when the connection owns it now — just given, or already its own —, false when another owns it. A policy that forbids it is CALL\_FAILED.

```go
func (*Conn) UniqueName() string
```

UniqueName is the connection's unique name on the bus (":1.42").

<a name="Conn.WatchName"></a>
### func \(Conn\) [WatchName](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/dbus/watch.go>)

```go
func (*Conn) WatchName(ctx context.Context, name string) (<-chan string, error)
```

WatchName returns a channel holding name's owner when the watch began — its unique name, empty for none —, then the owner after each change the bus announces, in order. It is closed when ctx ends, the match removed, or when the connection is. A name that is not well-known is NAME\_INVALID.

Goroutine lifecycle: one per watch, delivering its owners; ended by ctx or by the connection's end, and joined by Close.
